subject: Rotation chaos-drill: request for KV-cache traces and runbook artifacts
messages:
From: Lydia Patel <lydia.patel@clearsky.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: security@clearsky.com
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Evidence request: rotation chaos-drill and KV-cache traces

Hi Soojin,

We are running a final validation ahead of our internal SOC 2 point-in-time and want to exercise a rotation chaos-drill for tenant-level BYOK and ephemeral state. Specifically we need:

- A brief written runbook describing the chaos-drill steps used to trigger key rotation/fallback (can be redacted for internal ops IDs).
- KV-cache traces (prefix caching / eviction + rehydration) for a 1-hour window around the drill showing request IDs, timestamps, and any fallback routing.
- Signed HSM attestation for the key ceremony used during the window (scoped to control-plane operator IDs).

Can you confirm what you can provide and whether we need an SFTP or presigned S3 link for a secure handoff? Also let us know any PII redaction you apply to the traces.

Thanks — we want to close this before our auditor arrives on 2026-12-10.

Regards,
Lydia
Security Program Manager
ClearSky Financial

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Patel <lydia.patel@clearsky.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: rotation chaos-drill and KV-cache traces

Lydia —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide all three items. Quick notes and proposed handoff: 

- Runbook: we will extract a copy of the chaos-drill runbook (redacting internal node ids and staff emails). The runbook will include the exact sequence used to N+1 rotate tenant keys, verify KV-cache eviction, and validate fallback to the compatible model variant.

- KV-cache traces: we will produce a filtered tarball with request_id, utc_timestamp, shard_id, cache_event (hit/miss/evict/rehydrate), and the associated model_variant tag. We will redact request payloads and user identifiers, but preserve correlation IDs so ClearSky can map events in your audit.

- HSM attestation: Marissa will attach the signed attestation PDF and the operator separation matrix for the shift.

Handoff options: presigned S3 (preferred, time-limited) or SFTP. If S3, we'll send the presigned URLs once artifacts are staged. If SFTP is required, please share host/user instructions and an SFTP PGP key.

I plan to include a short integrity manifest (SHA256 checksums) and a small CSV that maps correlation IDs to the rotation sub-phase (start/evict/rotate/complete). 

Next steps: Marissa will package the files and I will drop the presigned links here. Expect the bundle within 6 business hours. If you need the raw unredacted traces for an internal forensics engagement, we will need a data access agreement addendum — please flag if that's the case.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Patel <lydia.patel@clearsky.com>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 15:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: rotation chaos-drill and KV-cache traces

Lydia — attaching the artifacts to this thread (see attachment stubs below). Contents:

1) rotation-runbook-v2.pdf (redacted) — steps, expected checks, rollback criteria, and runbook owner contact.
2) kvcache_traces_20261201.tar.gz (log snapshot) — CSVs: events.csv (request_id,utc_timestamp,shard_id,cache_event,model_variant,correlation_id), checksums.sha256.
3) hsm-attestation-2026-11-30.pdf — signed by HSM vendor and Redwood’s key-operations lead.

Attachment stubs: rotation-runbook-v2.pdf (application/pdf), kvcache_traces_20261201.tar.gz (application/gzip), hsm-attestation-2026-11-30.pdf (application/pdf).

Notes on redaction: we removed request payload bodies and replaced user_id with a stable hashed identifier (sha256 lowercased). Timestamps are in UTC. We also removed internal pod and hostnames but kept shard_id and correlation_id for your mapping. 

Handoff: presigned S3 links below (valid 72 hours):
- s3://redwood-evidence/CSK/CSK-2026-ENCRYPT-47/rotation-runbook-v2.pdf?presigned=true
- s3://redwood-evidence/CSK/CSK-2026-ENCRYPT-47/kvcache_traces_20261201.tar.gz?presigned=true
- s3://redwood-evidence/CSK/CSK-2026-ENCRYPT-47/hsm-attestation-2026-11-30.pdf?presigned=true

If you need an alternate delivery channel or PGP-encrypted archive, reply with the preferred method.

—Marissa
Principal, Crypto Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Lydia Patel <lydia.patel@clearsky.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 15:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: rotation chaos-drill and KV-cache traces

Marissa / Soojin —

Received the links and artifacts, thank you. A few quick clarifications from our auditor: 

- Can you confirm whether the KV-cache traces show any fallback to a lower-tier model_variant during the window and include the exact correlation_id mapping for two sample requests we provided (CSK-req-77 and CSK-req-91)?
- For the HSM attestation, can you include the public key thumbprint used to sign the PDF so our audit team can verify signatures locally?

If you can drop a short follow-up (1–2 lines) for each, we should be set. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Regards,
Lydia
Security Program Manager
ClearSky Financial
